summary: PsiTransfer is a self-hosted web application for sharing files directly from your server. It provides a straightforward interface that supports upload and download resumption alongside optional password protection.
goodFor: It suits anyone needing a lightweight, self-hosted drop-zone for transferring files to external users without setting up a full cloud storage suite.
watchOut: Development activity is slowing, and the project faces strong competition from more actively maintained file-sharing platforms.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a reverse proxy like Nginx or Caddy to handle TLS termination and persistent storage mounted for uploaded files.
